The 5th Carmen Awards ceremony, presented by the Andalusian Film Academy, took place on 31 January 2026 at the Conference & Exhibition Centre in Granada. There ceremony was broadcast on Canal Sur.
Background
In December 2025 the filmmaker Miguel Hermoso was announced as the recipient of the Honorary Carmen Award.  and Cristalino read the nominations from the stage of La Chumbera in Granada on 16 December 2025.
The gala was hosted by  while Zahara, Antonio José, Rosa López, anda  were announced as musical acts.
